say:1:1441129001:1.text: Without a ruler, Sal'thorin is now vulnerable. I can't seem to get through my duties and all this trivial work...
say:1:1441129001:1.source_cn: 一国无主，群狼环伺，还有这无尽的公务和琐事……

say:2:1441129002:1.text: Oh, Indris! You've really left me with a huge mess to clean up.
say:2:1441129002:1.source_cn: 因度厄可真是给我留下了不小的麻烦啊。

say:3:1441129003:1.text: Could this be the end of my peaceful and carefree life?
say:3:1441129003:1.source_cn: 难道我优美而闲散的生活就要这样结束了吗？

say:4:1441129004:1.text: I can't be the only one who suffers! This, this, and that...
say:4:1441129004:1.source_cn: 不行，他可别想躲着清闲……这些、还有这些……

say:5:1441129005:1.text: Let him take care of the trickiest stuff!
say:5:1441129005:1.source_cn: 这些最麻烦的事全都交给他吧！
